Title: Deep conditional generative model for personalization of 12-lead electrocardiograms and cardiovascular risk prediction
Abstract: Due to the relative slow speed of this algorithm, which usually takes 30-60 min for one case, we reconstruct a total of 1,834 3D torso meshes, and measure the ten <m>electrodes</m>' positions for standard 12-lead <m>ECGs</m>, which include four limb <m>electrodes</m> including left arm, right arm, left leg, and right leg, and six <m>precordial</m> <m>electrodes</m> corresponding to six <m>precordial</m> leads.

Title: Revolutionizing electrocardiography: the role of artificial intelligence in modern cardiac diagnostics
Abstract: Noises in <m>ECG</m> data can arise from various sources, such as muscle activity, baseline wander, motion <m>artifacts</m>, power-line interference, and <m>electrode</m> displacement.
